name: Laioutr
description: Laioutr is the agentic frontend management platform that combines Studio (visual editor), Frontend (performance layer), Orchestr (backend integrations), and Laioutr Cloud (hosting) into a single platform. Developers no longer need to manually maintain integrations, while marketing and content teams can independently design pages, launch campaigns, and manage content via a unified interface - without requiring an engineering ticket for every adjustment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Laioutr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Laioutr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cockpit.laioutr.cloud/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Laioutr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laioutr lists 23 MCP tools, including project_list, studio_add_array_item, studio_add_block, studio_add_global_section_reference, studio_add_section, studio_delete_block, studio_delete_section, studio_get_capabilities, studio_get_component_schemas, studio_get_data_model, studio_get_page_tree, and studio_get_prop.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Laioutr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Laioutr in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Laioutr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Laioutr is developed by Laioutr GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
